{{Top|leg}}
'''Stun generators''' were installed in weapons such as [[Force pike/Legends|force pikes]]<ref name="Guide">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> and [[Stokhli/Legends|Stokhli]] [[Spray stick/Legends|spray stick]]s.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> The generators were used to create [[Stun/Legends|stun]] settings for force pikes,<ref name="Guide" /> and to deliver an electrical stun charge through the [[Spraynet/Legends|spraynet]] on the Stokhli spray stick and in [[Stun net/Legends|stun nets]].<ref name="EGWT" />
